names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 februarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Agatodor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Αγαθόδωρος», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Agatodor»

attestations.note: The day is the Meeting of the Lord. His own page on the site carries the name, the date and the readings appointed for a martyr, and no life and no troparion.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Αγαθόδωρος»

attestations.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 2 February (civil 15.02.2026) was read whole on 4 October 2026 and does not name him: its two numbered entries are the Meeting of the Lord and the new martyr Jordan, and Jordan's closes on the monk Gabriel. So no Serbian row could be written for him from that page — which is a gap in this reading, not a finding that the Serbian church does not keep him.
